errors.evidence: The description correctly identifies the colors but omits the fill patterns (hatching and solid fill) that are used to distinguish the bars, as shown in the legend.
The description states the value for the 'no SFT' bar for LLaMA-2-7B is approximately 6%, but the bar's height is clearly below the 5% line, at approximately 4%.

The description states the value for the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bar for LLaMA-2-70B is approximately 45%. However, this bar is the tallest on the chart and its value is slightly above 50%. The value of 45% corresponds to the '+ SFT on D₀' bar for the same model.
